Providers.title: Your sources
Providers.intro: Connect your authorized playlist. Mosa does not provide content.
Providers.name: Connection name
Providers.demoNote: Synthetic content with an authorized demo video.
Providers.noPassword: Leave blank to keep the current password
Providers.limit: M3U lists up to 8 MB and 20,000 entries. If the provider sent a DNS and the list is larger, choose message credentials (Xtream).
Providers.stalkerNote: Enter only a MAC assigned or authorized by your provider. The Mosa Device ID cannot authenticate a portal. Other portal variants may differ.
Providers.optionalCode: App code/PIN (optional; does not authenticate Xtream)
Providers.savedServer: Or use a saved Xtream source address
Providers.quickNote: Use only the DNS supplied by your provider; webplayer sites are not necessarily Xtream servers. Without a DNS, select a saved Xtream source. The PIN is not used or stored.
Providers.quickGuide: Paste the message with username and password. Importing also requires the provider’s Xtream DNS/API or an M3U playlist.
Providers.xtreamGuide: Use the provider’s Xtream DNS/API with username and password. Do not paste the complete M3U playlist URL here.
Providers.m3uGuide: Use the complete playlist URL (get.php with parameters) or a .m3u file. Very large lists require Xtream.
Providers.stalkerGuide: Use only the portal address and provider-registered MAC; an Xtream username and password are not a MAC.
Providers.usePastedPlaylist: Use the M3U playlist URL found in the message
Providers.largePlaylist: The playlist exceeds 8 MB. If you have a DNS, username and password, use message credentials (Xtream) instead of importing this large list.
Providers.importNote: Check tests your credentials; Save also imports the catalog. Playback depends on the link, browser and provider permissions.
Providers.liveFormat: Live channel format (use TS if the message says output=ts)
Providers.missingCredentials: Paste a message with username and password, or enter them in advanced options.
Providers.missingServer: The source Xtream DNS/API is missing. Ask your provider or select an authorized server in advanced options. A Web Player URL is not a server.
Providers.webPlayerNotServer: If the message only provides a Web Player, ask your provider for the Xtream DNS/API or an M3U playlist. A Web Player URL cannot be used as the source address.
Providers.messageRecognized: Username, password and server found. Review them in advanced options if needed.
Providers.otherMethods: Another way to connect (Xtream, M3U or MAG)
Providers.epgUrl: EPG URL (optional; external guides are not imported yet)
Providers.connectionHelp: Check the server address and credentials. The Web Player address may differ from the Xtream API.
Providers.providerResponded: Provider authentication succeeded; individual videos were not tested.
Providers.localFileRequired: To refresh an uploaded file, import it again into a new profile.
